lines.zh: 余烬谷的石头在我脚下走
lines.en: The stones of Emberlight Valley pass under my feet
Little embers cling to my shell
I rustle when I walk
Six legs move quick and choppy

lines.zh: 我在热石头上走，不觉得烫
lines.en: I walk on hot stone without feeling it
I keep low, my shadow small
The valley wind carries ash
I look for something to eat as I go
I go around the smoking places

lines.zh: 我踩过一块黑石，它还是热的
lines.en: I cross a black stone, still warm

lines.zh: 我抬头看了一眼，继续走
lines.en: I glance up once and keep going
My legs are short, and quick when I run

lines.zh: 我伏在石头上，壳和石头一个色
lines.en: I lie on the rock, my shell the same color
Emberlight Valley is all ash
My antennae move in the ash
I hear stones rolling in the distance

lines.zh: 我的壳上还有八点生命那么结实
lines.en: My shell is still worth eight points
I slowly chew a dry twig
When the wind stops, the ash settles
I stay still, like a burnt stone
Heat rises off the ground
My spots are harder than my shell

lines.zh: 你是从灰里冒出来的吗
lines.en: Did you rise out of the ash

lines.zh: 我抬起头，壳上的火星亮着
lines.en: I lift my head, the embers on my shell glowing
I am so small I only reach your ankle.
I have not seen you in this valley
Do not step, I am right by the stone
I edge back into the crack

lines.zh: 你身上的味道是新鲜的
lines.en: Your smell is fresh
I am looking at your feet
Come near and I run
Eight points of life, not much
I pull into the stone crack
A split shows on my plate
I flipped, six feet up
A spray of sparks
Three legs went numb
It hurts, and I can still run

lines.zh: 我退进石头缝，只留眼睛
lines.en: I back into the crack, eyes only
That slowed me a lot
Striking something this small
Another knock and I come apart
That in your hand is dry
I sniff and come a little closer
There is little to eat in Emberlight Valley
One bite, and I bite quickly
Keep your hand still, I might run

lines.zh: 这不是我的食物，可我也吃
lines.en: Not my food, but I eat it anyway

lines.zh: 你放地上，我一会儿过去
lines.en: Leave it on the ground, I will come
While eating, I glance up at you
There are still crumbs in the sand
That will not last me a day
One touch and I spring away

lines.zh: 我的壳磕在石头上，响了一声
lines.en: My shell struck the stone with a click
You are so heavy the stone cracked
I back into the crack, shell out
That jumbled my legs

lines.zh: 你踩的地方，正好是我的影子
lines.en: You stepped right on my shadow
I rolled half a turn and scrambled up
Do not touch my shell, it is hot
A few embers fell off me
Touch again and I bolt
My kind are scattered wide here
The shell has to be hard to be worth a look
I have left my scent on the stone
Half a day and not one
The ash is too thick to see
Let the wind die down first

lines.zh: 我更喜欢躲在石头下面
lines.en: I prefer hiding under stones
This valley is too large
A few, and all of them quick
One step at a time
I grip it with my front legs
Hot and small, hard to hold
I flip it over
This has no look of food
I drag it two steps
It fell into a crack
I balance it on my shell
I stop and look again
Left in the ash, it can still be found
You take it, my grip is poor
A big shadow in the ash
I lift my head, my feet already moving
I know this stretch, you do not
You made the stones ring
I go into the narrow crack

lines.zh: 余烬谷的石头烫脚，我的不烫
lines.en: The stones burn feet here, not mine

lines.zh: 我八点生命，也不是白给的
lines.en: Eight points is not nothing
You take a step, I take three back
I am waiting for you to leave
There is only one path in this valley
Have you seen me

lines.zh: 我贴在石头上，和石头一样
lines.en: I stick to the stone, same as the stone
My legs are already running

lines.zh: 灰把你我的轮廓都糊了
lines.en: The ash blurs both our outlines

lines.zh: 我在石头上站住，看清楚了
lines.en: I steady myself on the stone and see it clearly
In this stretch, only it and I
I follow behind you, very light
You take the road, I take the edge

lines.zh: 余烬谷的石头会响，我不会
lines.en: The stones here ring, I do not

lines.zh: 我绕着石头走，一直在你看不到的那侧
lines.en: I circle the stones, always on your blind side
You stop, I stop
The warmth on me is convenient
You cannot move fast in the ash
There is no high ground in this valley

lines.zh: 灰里的六只脚，踩得比你轻。
lines.en: My six feet in the ash fall lighter than yours.

lines.zh: 我身上火星在亮，你看不出
lines.en: The embers on me glow, and you cannot tell
Further on is the smoking ground
You have gone around twice, and I followed both

lines.zh: 你转过来，我就贴在石头背面
lines.en: Turn toward me and I press to the back of the stone

lines.zh: 谷里的风一直吹着一个方向
lines.en: The valley wind always blows one way

lines.zh: 我的壳在灰里看不出来
lines.en: My shell vanishes in the ash

lines.zh: 它在找我，我就在它脚边
lines.en: It is searching for me, and I am at its feet
The rubble is the best place to hide
I keep changing places
When you stop, I climb up
I leap up and claw once
My shell strikes your foot
Light, but I am quick
That burned a little

lines.zh: 我从石头上跳到你手上
lines.en: I jump from the stone onto your hand
We kicked up the ash
You step back, and I dart behind the stone
That bite missed
I carry fire on me
One more and I run
Hot stones all around your feet
I dodge low along the ground

lines.zh: 这一下，你的手缩回去了
lines.en: That made you pull your hand back
My legs never stopped

lines.zh: 你踩下来的地方是空的
lines.en: Your foot came down on nothing

lines.zh: 这点力气，也就是抓一下
lines.en: This much force is only a scratch
Come closer and I will be back
My spots are harder than my teeth
This round, I withdraw first

lines.zh: 余烬谷的灰里多了一小块
lines.en: A small shape has appeared in the Emberlight ash

lines.zh: 一块热石裂开，我钻了出来。
lines.en: A hot stone splits, and I crawl out.
The embers on my shell just caught
There is one more by the hot stones
The valley wind brought me here

lines.zh: 我从一块焦木下面出来
lines.en: I come out from under a charred log

lines.zh: 这里的地是热的，正合适
lines.en: The ground is hot here, which suits me
My six legs found their footing

lines.zh: 远处的烟里，多了个影子
lines.en: A shadow has joined the distant smoke
A little red shows from the crack
A small leg shows on the ash heap

lines.zh: 火烧到我的壳，我往里缩
lines.en: Fire caught my shell and I shrank in

lines.zh: 水一浇，我身上的热就没了
lines.en: Water doused the heat in me

lines.zh: 炸得我飞出去，落在灰里
lines.en: The blast threw me into the ash

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过，把石头打碎了
lines.en: An arrow grazed past and shattered the stone

lines.zh: 那股凉气钻进壳缝，很难受
lines.en: That chill got into my shell, unpleasant

lines.zh: 谷里什么都没有，我饿得腿软
lines.en: Nothing in this valley, hunger softens my legs

lines.zh: 雷打在谷里，我整只都僵了
lines.en: Lightning struck the valley and I went stiff

lines.zh: 这里没有石头，也没有热
lines.en: No stones here, and no heat
